rows.text: 32 % of the bugs of PI 26.4 were found in production, against 20 % in PI 26.3. That is 18 of 56.
The share of bugs found in production doubled since PI 26.3.
payment-gateway holds 39 % of the production bugs of PI 26.4. Start there.
24 % of the fixed bugs came back after their fix. In the increment before it was 13 %.
Regression is the cause behind 38 % of the fixed bugs of PI 26.4: old behaviour broken by new work.
The backlog grows: 29 bugs are open now, 16 were open at the end of PI 26.3, and each sprint brings 2.3 more than it resolves.
14 open bugs are older than 30 days. Decide on each: fix it, or close it and say why.
Half of the fixed bugs took 13.6 days or less. Read it with care: the slow ones are still open and are not in this number yet.
Unreviewed merges move with production bugs a sprint later: r 0.65 over 18 sprints, a moderate link. With so few sprints it could be as low as 0.27.
Late scope and overload show a weaker link (r 0.4 and 0.31). With so few sprints both could be chance.
Sprint 41 brought 11 new bugs, inside the usual range of 7 to 13.
